**Observation Log:**

[FACT] The session date is 2023/09/18 (Mon) at 12:49.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a revised draft of a policy memorandum dated February 8, 2023.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The memorandum is addressed to WIB WIOA Title I Subrecipients from Adam Peck, Executive Director.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The subject of the memorandum is "Guidance on Virtual Service Delivery of WIOA Title I Career and Youth Services."

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The purpose of the memo is to provide guidance on virtual services for WIOA Title I Eligibility and Youth and Career and Training Services for the Workforce Investment Board of Tulare County (WIB) subrecipients.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The guidance prioritizes virtual services that assist individuals with urgent enrollment needs during the COVID-19 pandemic.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The policy supersedes previous guidance titled "Maximizing Distance Technology for WIOA Title I Registration," dated March 31, 2020, and "Activities and Service Delivery for Remote Services," dated July 23, 2020.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Remote services are defined as the exchange of information through virtual platforms like Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, or others.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Remote services should be meaningful, engaging, and equivalent to in-person services.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Subrecipients should ensure virtual services are accessible to all customers, including those lacking technology or reliable internet.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] When in-person or remote services are not viable, subrecipients should consider meeting customers at alternative locations.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Subrecipients should regularly evaluate the effectiveness of remote services using metrics like customer satisfaction, enrollment rates, and employment outcomes.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] All aspects of service delivery should be designed with the needs and interests of customers in mind.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Customers may access WIOA Title I program services remotely or in-person based on their preferences or needs.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Subrecipients should use the CalJOBS Eligibility Explorer Application for remote eligibility and document uploads.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Intake staff must protect customers' Personal Identifiable Information (PII) during the process.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Eligibility documents must be uploaded to CalJOBS through the Eligibility Explorer Application, or an in-person appointment should be scheduled.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Staff should enter a case note of the customer's request for a remote eligibility appointment.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Upon completing eligibility, customers shall have access to a career coach the same day for an initial assessment, objective assessment, and My Action Plan.

[ASSISTANT
